title: Agovar

paragraphs: Hyman cites Eruvin 62a for the synagogue of the household of Agovar in Rava’s time. In [Taanit 26a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.26a.1), Rav Papa comes to the synagogue of Avi Gover. Hyman says Rashi explains this as a person’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The synagogue occurs at [Eruvin 61b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.61b.8-9), where Mar Yehudah speaks and Rava answers him. In Taanit, [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Taanit.26a.1.2) allows a person’s name or a place name.
